chunks: And whatever was in it from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, and Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, all from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: all together; indicating that both named transmitters relate from the same narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicating direct transmission by the compiler through this chain
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; one of the compiler’s immediate authorities in transmission
key_terms.عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ: from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān; the source narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material.
